title: Super to see Volkswagen Group putting Copilot to work across the company!
summary: Super to see Volkswagen Group putting Copilot to work across the company! | 157 comments on LinkedIn
body_markdown: 🚗 Wonderful news for our longstanding partnership with Volkswagen! More than 330,000[Volkswagen Group](https://de.linkedin.com/company/volkswagen-group?trk=public_post_reshare-text) employees will have access to Microsoft Copilot, helping teams use AI across roles from engineering and production to procurement and sales. What excites me most is what this can mean for employees: making everyday work more efficient and giving people more time to focus on analytical, creative and higher-value tasks. 🤝 This next step builds on our collaboration with Volkswagen Group and its broader digital transformation. It’s a great example of how AI can be brought to people at scale, while keeping employees at the center. A heartfelt thank you to Team Volkswagen,[Hauke Stars](https://de.linkedin.com/in/haukestars?trk=public_post_reshare-text) ,[Sophie Vassarotti](https://de.linkedin.com/in/vassarotti?trk=public_post_reshare-text) ,[Mario Daberkow](https://de.linkedin.com/in/mario-daberkow-b9318824?trk=public_post_reshare-text) ,[Dr. Tibor Farkas](https://de.linkedin.com/in/dr-tibor-farkas-7ba19415b?trk=public_post_reshare-text) Arpita Thakur[Florian Zoerlein](https://de.linkedin.com/in/florian-zoerlein-81aa44246?trk=public_post_reshare-text) (and many more) as well as Team Microsoft,[Christoph Struck](https://de.linkedin.com/in/christoph-struck-54581127?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Anatoli Grabowski](https://de.linkedin.com/in/anatoli-grabowski?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Christian Simon](https://de.linkedin.com/in/simon-microsoft?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Rupert Stuetzle](https://de.linkedin.com/in/rupert-stuetzle-2001283?trk=public_post_reshare-text) Dayan Rodriguez[Joachim Franz](https://at.linkedin.com/in/joachimfranz?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Claudia Scheuber](https://de.linkedin.com/in/claudia-scheuber-a108b179?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Jorge Alvarado](https://de.linkedin.com/in/jorge-alvarado-1b0036104?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Andreas Kelly](https://de.linkedin.com/in/andreas-kelly?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Andreas Exner](https://de.linkedin.com/in/andreas--exner?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Michael Ehrhardt](https://de.linkedin.com/in/michael-ehrhardt?trk=public_post_reshare-text)[Diego Aviles Escobar](https://de.linkedin.com/in/avilesdiego?trk=public_post_reshare-text) and everyone involved for reaching this exciting next milestone together.
